entries.why: The babel-eslint README says babel-eslint is now @babel/eslint-parser and has moved into the Babel monorepo.
The npm deprecation message of coffee-script says CoffeeScript on npm has moved to coffeescript, without the hyphen.
The gulp-util README says the module is deprecated and lists vinyl, fancy-log and plugin-error as replacements for parts of it.
The npm deprecation message of hoek says the module has moved and is now available at @hapi/hoek.
The npm deprecation message of istanbul says the module is no longer maintained and suggests installing nyc.
The pug rename issue says jade was renamed to pug and that there will be no 2.0.0 release of jade.
The npm deprecation message of the launcher says PhantomJS development has stopped and suggests puppeteer or similar.
The Moment project status docs recommend Luxon, Day.js and date-fns as alternatives to Moment.
The npm deprecation message of node-sass says it is no longer supported and recommends sass or sass-embedded.
The npm deprecation message of node-uuid says to use the uuid module instead.
The request maintainers collected alternative libraries after deprecating request, and the list names node-fetch, got and axios.
The TSLint deprecation issue says the project is deprecated in favor of ESLint and refers to the typescript-eslint roadmap.
The npm deprecation message of uglify-es says its ECMAScript support is superseded by uglify-js as of v3.13.0.
The Beautiful Soup page says version 3 was discontinued on January 1, 2021 and tells users to migrate to Beautiful Soup 4, installed as beautifulsoup4.
The distribute page says it is a legacy package that is a compatibility layer installing Setuptools 0.7 or later.
The mysqlclient 1.3.7 page on PyPI says mysqlclient is a fork of MySQL-python that adds Python 3 support.
The nose documentation says it has been in maintenance mode for years and suggests Nose2, pytest or plain unittest for new projects.
The oauth2client README says the library is deprecated and recommends google-auth and oauthlib.
The pycodestyle README says the tool was formerly called pep8.
The Pillow README says Pillow is the friendly fork of PIL, the Python Imaging Library.
The PyCrypto site says PyCrypto 2.x is unmaintained and obsolete and recommends cryptography or its fork PyCryptodome.
The sklearn page on PyPI says the package is deprecated and tells users to install scikit-learn instead.
The tensorflow-gpu page on PyPI says the package has been removed and tells users to install tensorflow instead.
The advisory says the maintainer deprecated ansi_term and lists nu-ansi-term and owo-colors among possible alternatives.
The advisory says bincode is unmaintained and lists wincode, postcard, bitcode and rkyv as alternatives to consider.
The advisory says dotenv is unmaintained and lists dotenvy as a possible alternative.
The advisory says failure is end-of-life and deprecated by its maintainer, and suggests alternatives including thiserror and anyhow.
The advisory says fxhash is no longer maintained and suggests rustc-hash instead.
The advisory says instant is no longer maintained and that the author recommends the web-time crate instead.
The advisory says the memmap author is unresponsive and lists memmap2 as a maintained alternative.
The advisory says net2 has been deprecated and encourages users to consider socket2 instead.
The advisory says proc-macro-error is unmaintained and lists manyhow and proc-macro2-diagnostics as possible alternatives.
The advisory says serde_cbor is unmaintained and lists ciborium and minicbor as alternatives proposed by the author.
The structopt README says its features are integrated into clap v3 and that structopt is in maintenance mode.
The advisory says tempdir has been deprecated and that its functionality is merged into tempfile.
The advisory says the tui crate is no longer maintained and suggests the ratatui crate instead.
The advisory says yaml-rust is unmaintained and suggests switching to the yaml-rust2 fork.
